summary: Answer strict exact named Email-thread membership questions from the existing hash-only workflow index.
decision_refs: The active objective requires adaptable file-grounded Email support alongside RFI and Submittal questions
The workflow index already preserves bounded hash-only Email thread membership and parent-before-reply order
A deterministic local answer avoids unnecessary model cost and raw Message-ID exposure
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact EML or MSG file use the local shortcut.
Thread membership and order come only from the existing exact hash-header relationships.
Missing or duplicate names, malformed or ambiguous relationships and more than eight members fail closed.
The shortcut does not connect to a mailbox or infer participants, delivery, semantic chronology, contractual effect or authority.
